Closes #28

## Summary
- The `Overdue` label added in STORY-013 (#27) now has its own style: bold, dark red `#a40000`. That gives about 8:1 contrast on the white page background, well above the WCAG AA minimum of 4.5:1.
- The word "Overdue" still carries the meaning: the label is text, so the colour only reinforces it.
- The existing axe audit now also covers an overdue task in the Active view and a past-dated completed task in the Completed view, with no violations.
- One CSS rule in `index.html`; there are no code changes, and no external resources are loaded (REQ-018).

## Risks / notes for reviewer
- **Contrast is checked against the white page background.** The app has no dark theme. If one is added later, `.task-overdue` needs a matching colour.
- **AC1's contrast test** computes the WCAG ratio in the browser, from the computed colour and the nearest painted background (white when none is set). axe's `color-contrast` rule checks the same thing independently in AC2.
- `ariaSnapshot()` (Playwright 1.63) is used for AC4 to read the row the way assistive technology sees it.

## Out of scope / follow-ups
- This is the last story of increment `002-add-due-dates`. After it is merged and closed out, every REQ of the increment (REQ-022 to REQ-026) is implemented.
- Not planned: a "Due today" label, an overdue filter or view, and a dark theme.

## How to review (Gate B)
- **To request changes:** comment on this PR with `/changes` on the first line, followed by your feedback. Then run `/factory-resume`. The factory reworks this same PR and replies to each point.
- **To approve:** merge this PR yourself. Your merge is the approval. The factory never merges.
- After merging, run `/factory-resume` to close out the story. The factory will not start the next story until you run `/factory-continue`.
